name: CLI release smoke

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "30 4 * * 1"

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  release-smoke:
    timeout-minutes: 20
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    environment:
      name: development
    env:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://
      AUTH_SECRET: test
      WEBSTUDIO_RELEASE_SMOKE_TOKEN_BUDGET: 6000
      WEBSTUDIO_RELEASE_SMOKE_REPORT: ${{ github.workspace }}/artifacts/cli-release-smoke.json
      WEBSTUDIO_RELEASE_SMOKE_AGENT_COMMAND: ${{ vars.CLI_RELEASE_SMOKE_AGENT_COMMAND }}
      WEBSTUDIO_RELEASE_SMOKE_AGENT_REPORT: ${{ github.workspace }}/artifacts/cli-release-smoke-model.json
      CLI_RELEASE_SMOKE_AGENT_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.CLI_RELEASE_SMOKE_AGENT_API_KEY }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: ./.github/actions/submodules-checkout
        with:
          submodules-ssh-key: ${{ secrets.PRIVATE_GITHUB_DEPLOY_TOKEN }}

      - uses: ./.github/actions/ci-setup

      - name: Run packaged CLI and agent onboarding smoke
        run: pnpm --filter webstudio test:release-smoke

      - name: Upload compact comparison report
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: cli-release-smoke-comparison
          path: artifacts/cli-release-smoke.json
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Upload dual-package model evaluation report
        if: ${{ always() && vars.CLI_RELEASE_SMOKE_AGENT_COMMAND != '' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: cli-release-smoke-model-evaluation
          path: artifacts/cli-release-smoke-model.json
          if-no-files-found: error

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
